title: Gamer: A Generalist Vision-Language-Action Foundation Model for Long-Horizon Real-Time Game Agent
abstract: arXiv:2611.18397v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce Gamer, a generalist agent framework built for long-horizon tasks in complex interactive environments. Its end-to-end architecture combines perception, memory management, and multi-step reasoning. A shared training and deployment pipeline supports interaction with both conventional 2D graphical interfaces and complex 3D simulated worlds. We first continue pre-training on a dataset constructed from tens of thousands of hours of device-level keyboard and mouse interaction. These trajectories span simulated games and embodied environments, allowing the model to learn environmental dynamics across both physical and virtual domains. Sparse-thinking instruction tuning then substantially reduces redundant computation while preserving the reasoning needed for complex decisions. translated_title: Gamer：面向长时程实时游戏智能体的通用视觉-语言-动作基础模型
translated_abstract: 我们提出了Gamer，一个专为复杂交互环境中长时程任务构建的通用智能体框架。其端到端架构结合了感知、记忆管理和多步推理。统一的训练与部署流程支持与常规2D图形界面以及复杂3D模拟世界的交互。我们首先在从数万小时设备级键盘和鼠标交互中构建的数据集上进行继续预训练，这些轨迹涵盖模拟游戏和具身环境，使模型能够学习跨物理与虚拟领域的环境动态。随后的稀疏思考指令微调在保留复杂决策所需推理能力的同时，大幅减少了冗余计算。我们采用一种稳定的多轮强化学习方法来训练策略以实现长时程交互，该方法解决了有限上下文窗口、累积（误差/奖励）等问题（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 提出Gamer，一个端到端的通用视觉-语言-动作基础模型，通过海量键鼠交互轨迹预训练、稀疏思考指令微调和稳定的多轮强化学习，实现了在复杂2D/3D交互环境中执行长时程任务的实时游戏智能体。
en_tdlr: Gamer is a generalist vision-language-action foundation model that leverages large-scale keyboard-mouse interaction pretraining, sparse-thinking instruction tuning, and stable multi-turn reinforcement learning to enable real-time agents for long-horizon tasks in complex 2D/3D interactive environments.
